metadata.description: A router over 200+ skills grouped by industry, plus a vetter that checks third-party skills before you install them. Updated weekly by GitHub Actions.

plugins.name: skill-hub
plugins.description: master-skill routes any task to the best skill from industry packs (AI/ML, MLOps, careers, dev, data, design, legal, finance...). skill-vetter security-vets third-party skills and installs them pinned to a commit. job-search-copilot and ml-interview-prep cover resumes, applications and ML/AI interview prep.
